sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_cnt FROM ub LIMIT 1000
SELECT behavior_type, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM ub GROUP BY behavior_type ORDER BY behavior_count DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyer_count FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' LIMIT 1000
SELECT d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM ub GROUP BY d ORDER BY d LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 4) AS avg_pv_per_user FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'pv' LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 4) AS pay_rate FROM ub LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN buy_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS repurchase_rate FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS buy_cnt FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id) AS t LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 4) AS avg_buy_times_per_buyer FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) AS buyer_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN user_id END) AS cart_user_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN user_id END), 4) AS cart_to_buy_rate FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') LIMIT 1000

WITH hourly AS (SELECT h, SUM(behavior_type = 'pv') AS pv_cnt, SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') AS buy_cnt FROM ub GROUP BY h) SELECT h, pv_cnt, buy_cnt, ROUND(buy_cnt / NULLIF(pv_cnt, 0), 4) AS buy_conversion_rate FROM hourly WHERE pv_cnt > 0 ORDER BY buy_conversion_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH active_1125 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-25'), active_1126 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-26') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(a1126.user_id) / COUNT(a1125.user_id), 4) AS next_day_retention_rate FROM active_1125 AS a1125 LEFT JOIN active_1126 AS a1126 ON a1125.user_id = a1126.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH base AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-28'), ret AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-12-01') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id), 4) AS retention_3d FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN ret AS r ON b.user_id = r.user_id LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM user_rfm WHERE segment = '重要价值客户' LIMIT 1000
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS user_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_rfm), 4) AS user_share FROM user_rfm GROUP BY segment ORDER BY user_cnt DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN segment = '重要价值客户' THEN frequency ELSE 0 END) / SUM(frequency) * 100, 4) AS contribution_pct FROM user_rfm LIMIT 1000
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS buy_cnt FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY buy_cnt DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) AS buy_category_count FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' LIMIT 1000

WITH combo AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'cart') AS has_cart, MAX(behavior_type = 'fav') AS has_fav, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS has_buy FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'fav', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_cnt, SUM(has_buy) AS buy_combo_cnt, ROUND(SUM(has_buy) / COUNT(*), 4) AS buy_conversion_rate FROM combo WHERE has_cart = 1 AND has_fav = 0 LIMIT 1000

WITH cart_buy AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN ts END) AS cart_ts, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN ts END) AS buy_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id HAVING NOT cart_ts IS NULL AND NOT buy_ts IS NULL AND buy_ts > cart_ts) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN buy_ts - cart_ts <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS ratio_24h FROM cart_buy LIMIT 1000
SELECT behavior_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-12-01' GROUP BY behavior_type ORDER BY FIELD(behavior_type, 'pv', 'fav', 'cart', 'buy') LIMIT 1000
